assignment: ENGL 101, Essay 3 — Municipal broadband: should city governments build and operate their own broadband networks? Take a position, support it with at least two sources, and address at least one objection. 750–1100 words, MLA-style in-text citations.
_note: Criteria describe what a grader looks for evidence OF. No criterion carries a scale, a level, or a weight. A rubric with a points column would put a number in the one place this system is built not to produce one, and Karani's analyst never sees a scale because there is none to see.

criteria.name: Thesis and controlling claim
criteria.description: A position on the question is stated, and the essay's later paragraphs are governed by it.

criteria.name: Evidence and source use
criteria.description: Sources are introduced, quoted or paraphrased accurately, cited, and connected to the claim they are offered in support of.

criteria.name: Organization and coherence
criteria.description: Paragraphs follow an order a reader can track, and transitions mark the relationship between them.

criteria.name: Engagement with counterarguments
criteria.description: An objection to the essay's position is stated and then responded to, rather than named and abandoned.

criteria.name: Sentence-level clarity and mechanics
criteria.description: Sentence boundaries, agreement, and punctuation are handled such that the argument is followable at the sentence level.
